_note: Copy this to ~/.config/abm-1to1/ad_accounts.json and fill it in. It is never committed. 'allowed' is the ONLY account this toolchain may write to; adding to it is a deliberate act. 'known_foreign' is optional and exists so a refusal can say WHY an id was rejected rather than just 'not allowed' - put any account your token can see but must never touch.

allowed.000000000: Your own ad account, the only one this may write to

known_foreign.111111111: An account your token can see but does not own
